home.practice_refining_blurb: Sort a refinery's tower so the columns that reach the outlet are pure vapour. Clear columns in a row pay more and more; tar sinks to the sump.
refining.title: Refining
refining.how_to: The tower holds three fractions: vapour, oil and tar. Swaps are diagonal, along a link: vapour rises past oil and sinks past tar, oil rises past tar and sinks past vapour, tar rises past vapour and sinks past oil. Keep dragging to carry a piece through several swaps. Every few seconds the rightmost column is drawn. More tar than vapour and it sinks; otherwise it rises to the tank. A column of pure vapour is clear, and each clear column in a row pays more than the last.
refining.how_to_keyboard: Arrows move the cursor; Q, W, E, A, S and D step round the honeycomb. Space picks the piece under it; the next step swaps it that way. Enter draws the outlet now.
refining.cycle_note: Swaps are diagonal. Vapour over tar, tar over oil and oil over vapour can swap: a pair the other way round cannot, so no swap is undone straight away.
refining.run_note: A column that sinks with no vapour in it is a dump: it leaves the clear run alone. Any other column that is not clear ends the run.
refining.smoke_note: Vapour that sinks is spilled. Every second vapour spilled comes back as smoke, which spoils a clear column.
refining.draw_note: Draw early when the outlet is ready: tap the outlet's lamp over the tower, or press enter.
refining.hint_note: Practice rounds ring a swap worth making when you pause.
refining.stage.clears_intro: Swap along the links to fill the outlet with vapour before it is drawn. Pure vapour is a clear column.
refining.stage.runs_intro: Clear columns in a row pay more each time. Send tar down in dumps: they leave the run alone.
refining.stage.full_intro: Spilled vapour comes back as smoke, and catalysts pay in a clean column but never move.
refining.legend_vapour: Vapour: the light fraction. A column of it is clear.
refining.legend_oil: Oil: the middle fraction. Rises, but spoils a clear column.
refining.legend_tar: Tar: the heavy fraction. More tar than vapour sinks a column.
refining.legend_smoke: Smoke: spilled vapour come back. Weighs and swaps as vapour, spoils a clear column.
refining.legend_catalyst: Catalyst: never moves. Pays in a clear or smooth column.
refining.legend_links: A dot between two pieces is a link: those two can swap.
refining.legend_outlet: The column on the right is the outlet. Its lamp says how it would go if drawn now.
studio.preset.refining_rich_feed: Rich feed: half the feed is vapour
studio.preset.refining_lean_feed: Lean feed: a third is vapour
studio.preset.refining_slow_burn: Slow burn: a draw every twelve seconds
studio.preset.refining_fast_burn: Fast burn: a draw every five seconds
studio.preset.refining_catalyst_rich: Catalyst rich: one piece in ten
